title: Best AI Website Builder for Restaurants in 2026
summary: We scored eight AI website builders on the eight things that actually matter to a restaurant: a menu that's easy to update, online ordering or reservations, and a site that loads fast on a phone at dinner rush.
body_markdown: With a tool that generates a real menu database, like Blink, Wix, Squarespace, Base44, or Lovable, an owner can edit items and prices directly. Tools that treat the menu as a static page or PDF, common on faster template builders, require a manual re-upload or a developer for every change.
